survey: A green spiral water slide descends from a raised yellow platform, curves around a central yellow support column and empties into the pool. Its continuous trough has raised sidewalls containing the water. The column rests on a broad circular foot on the tiled deck; a diagonal brace supports the platform. A blue ladder rests on two feet and hooks over the platform edge. Yellow posts and rails guard the platform, leaving access at the ladder and slide entrance. The slide outlet faces the camera and projects over the pool.
